issues.description: The exercise requires `Developer` to implement an instance method named `attend(course:)`, but the reference solution instead implements `participateIn(course:)` and never provides `attend(course:)`. This breaks the intended API contract: students following the problem statement/template (and any tests expecting `attend(course:)`) will not match the solution, and the solution’s own client code calls the wrong method name relative to the spec.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename `participateIn(course:)` in the solution to `attend(course:)` (and update the call site in `Client.main()`), or add an `attend(course:)` method that forwards to `participateIn(course:)` while keeping the behavior identical.
